chapters.label: Live: the 2012 World Cup
chapters.text: The 2012 Futsal World Cup quarter-final: Argentina against Brazil, no goals yet. Fernandinho races clean through, but Santiago Elías gets down fast. Two saves in one second!

chapters.label: Replay: the crossbar camera
chapters.text: Watch again from the crossbar. Low and quick, he drops to stop Fernandinho. Gabriel heads the rebound, and he blocks that too!

chapters.label: How he does it (demo)
chapters.text: How he does it: knees bent, on his toes, hands low. A shot fizzes at his feet, and he snaps down like a wall.

chapters.label: Practise it
chapters.text: Get down quickly to stop low shots near your feet. Hands down, save!
